cloud.install.handoff.start: Handing over to the new version (agents keep running)…

cloud.install.node.download: Downloading Node {version} for the station (once per version)…
cloud.install.node.failed: Couldn't download Node {version} from {origin}; run the install command again once the network is back
cloud.install.node.mismatch: The downloaded Node {version} failed its checksum and wasn't installed; run the install command again
cloud.install.release.mismatch: The downloaded station doesn't match its signature and wasn't installed: the download may have been replaced
cloud.install.unsupported: Only macOS (Apple silicon), Linux (x64, arm64) and Windows (x64) are supported for now; this machine is {machine}
cloud.install.upToDate: still.fail station is already up to date ({version}); no update needed
cloud.install.updateNoToken: A station already in a workspace needs no token to update: stillfail update
cloud.install.updated: still.fail station updated; running agents weren't interrupted
cloud.install.usage: Usage: curl -fsSL {origin}/install.sh | sh -s -- <token> (get the token from Add station in still.fail)

cloud.install.where.linger: To keep it running when no one is logged in, run: sudo loginctl enable-linger {user}
cloud.install.where.noService: No systemd user services on this machine: the station runs in the background now but won't start after a reboot; run stillfail start then
cloud.install.where.status: Status: stillfail status (which workspace, whether it's online, why it isn't working)
cloud.install.win.noGit: On Windows the station runs jobs and commands with Git Bash (Claude Code needs it there too), which this machine doesn't have yet: install Git for Windows (https://git-scm.com/download/win)
cloud.install.win.pathAdded: Added {dir} to your PATH; stillfail is available in new terminals
cloud.install.win.stopping: Stopping the running station to install the new version (interrupted turns resume after it restarts)…
cloud.install.win.cmdPath: The stillfail command can't use this path: {path} (it contains non-ASCII characters and isn't in your user folder). Set STILLFAIL_DATA to an ASCII-only data directory and try again.
cloud.install.win.task: Starts at Windows sign-in: scheduled task "{task}"
cloud.install.win.taskFailed: Couldn't register the scheduled task that starts the station at sign-in ({why}); the station is running now, but after you sign in again, run stillfail start manually
cloud.install.win.usage: Usage: & ([scriptblock]::Create((irm {origin}/install.ps1))) <token> (in PowerShell; get the token from Add station in still.fail)
cloud.install.where.wslKeep: This is WSL on Windows: when no WSL window is open, Windows stops WSL, and the station stops with it. To keep it running, have Windows run this at sign-in: wsl.exe -d {distro} --exec sleep infinity
cloud.install.where.wslKept: Windows starts WSL ({distro}) in the background at sign-in and keeps it running, so the station stays online (via stillfail-station-{distro}.vbs in your Startup folder; delete it to stop this)
cloud.install.where.wslSystemd: This is WSL on Windows without systemd: the station runs in the background now but stops whenever WSL does. To keep it running, add the two lines [boot] and systemd=true to /etc/wsl.conf (with sudo), run wsl --shutdown in Windows PowerShell, then open WSL and run this install command again.
